events.description: Free hour of golden-age Christmas standards in the style of Bing Crosby, Nat King Cole and Frank Sinatra from Bay Area swing-jazz group Vintage Noise. Best for adults and teens; no registration.

events.title: AFTER GLOW at the Ferry Building
events.description: After the Let's Glow SF countdown lights up the clock tower, the Ferry Building hosts a silent disco on the plaza, free cookie decorating and holiday crafts inside, letters to Santa with SF Etsy, cider and cocoa samples and holiday shopping. Drinks for purchase.

events.title: VIRUS Weightlifting Finals
events.description: USA Weightlifting's season-ending national finals, with the country's top lifters chasing titles and records. 8 a.m.-10 p.m. daily; see the event website for admission and the full schedule. Parking $15.

events.title: Garden of D'Lights: Holiday Sweater Night
events.venue: The Ruth Bancroft Garden & Nursery, 1552 Bancroft Rd
events.description: Themed night at the garden's holiday light show: wear your ugliest sweater and stroll the lights, sculptures and lasers to holiday classics. Evening nursery shopping, with cocoa, spiced wine and beer for sale.

events.title: Garden of D'Lights: Disco Night
events.venue: The Ruth Bancroft Garden & Nursery, 1552 Bancroft Rd
events.description: New Year's Day themed night at the Garden of D'Lights: sequins, sparkle and disco hits among the lights. Timed entry at 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 p.m.

events.title: Garden of D'Lights: Intergalactic Adventure Night
events.venue: The Ruth Bancroft Garden & Nursery, 1552 Bancroft Rd
events.description: Sci-fi costume night at the Garden of D'Lights: come as your favorite galactic hero or villain. Timed entry at 5:30 and 6:30 p.m.

events.title: Holiday Festival at Wente Family Vineyards
events.description: Family holiday evening in Wente's winter-wonderland Barrel Room with carolers, local vendors, hands-on crafts and photos with Santa. $75.

events.title: The Holiday Chalet at McGrail Vineyards
events.venue: McGrail Vineyards and Winery, 5600 Greenville Rd
events.description: An apres-ski party inspired by an '80s holiday in the French Alps, with a welcome glass of sparkling wine and light bites. '70s and '80s ski attire encouraged. $65-$75.

events.title: Guzheng Performance with Malina Mei
events.description: Sunday performance on the guzheng, the traditional Chinese zither. Included with general admission.

events.title: Philharmonia Baroque: Baroque Brilliance
events.description: Holiday-season program of Handel's "Let the Bright Seraphim," Bach's Jauchzet Gott, Telemann's Burlesque de Quixotte, a C.P.E. Bach cello concerto and a West Coast premiere by Marianna Martines. $40-$125.

events.title: Angel Blue and Bryan Wagorn
events.description: Two-time Grammy-winning soprano Angel Blue makes her San Francisco Performances debut with Met Opera pianist Bryan Wagorn, singing Purcell, Handel, Mozart, Strauss's Four Last Songs, Barber, Gershwin and spirituals. $65-$85.

events.title: The Great Yule Log Hunt
events.source: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
events.description: 32nd annual hunt for the fabled Yule Log with Ranger Eric: games and tales of old Yule celebrations, the hunt itself, then wassail, treats and making Yule logs to take home. Free with registration; canceled if raining.

events.title: SF Opera: The Velveteen Rabbit Family Event
events.venue: Taube Atrium Theater, War Memorial Veterans Building, 401 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Family afternoon around Caroline Altman's 50-minute holiday opera: activities and a Bunny Buffet lunch, a performance of The Velveteen Rabbit, then a meet-and-greet with the cast plus cookies and treats. Ticketed.

events.title: Reindeer Games (People's Circus Theatre)
events.venue: Creativity Theater, Children's Creativity Museum, 221 4th St
events.description: Fourth year of the family holiday circus show mixing interactive games, circus acts and a story about Santa's reindeer. Previews Dec 15-16 at 7 p.m.; shows Dec 19-20, 22-23 and 26-27 at 11 a.m. and 2 p.m. About 90 minutes, all ages. Tickets from $20.

events.title: San Francisco Girls Chorus: Annual Winter Concert
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: The chorus's winter tradition returns to Davies Symphony Hall for an evening of seasonal songs and choral music.

events.title: Disney's Frozen Movie Sing-Along
events.venue: Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.description: Sing along to Frozen on the big screen with special guest hostess "Ice Princess Tara."

events.title: Winter Lip Balm Workshop
events.venue: Alcosta Senior and Community Center, 9300 Alcosta Blvd
events.description: A hands-on class in making natural lip balm from scratch: you leave with two tubes and a guide for making more at home, handy for holiday gifts.

events.title: Holiday Lotion Bar Workshop
events.venue: Alcosta Senior and Community Center, 9300 Alcosta Blvd
events.description: Learn to make an all-natural lotion bar to give as a homemade holiday present, with take-home instructions for making more.

events.title: Winter Wassail at Crow Canyon Gardens
events.venue: Crow Canyon Gardens, 2500 Bollinger Canyon Rd
events.description: The city's third annual wassail mixes some history on the old custom that led to modern caroling with garden tastings, sips of cider and a Morris dance performance. Heavy rain cancels or reschedules.

events.title: Star Party at Amador Rancho
events.venue: Amador Rancho Community Center, 1998 Rancho Park Loop
events.description: Local astronomy clubs and DarkSky volunteers talk about the night sky, light pollution and what to look for this season, with indoor and outdoor parts. Rain or clouds cancel or reschedule it.

events.title: Shifting Worlds: A Photography Exchange (Opening Party)
events.venue: Bedford Gallery, Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.description: Opening night for a joint show by the Bay Area Photographers Collective and Yokohama's Samurai Foto, about change and impermanence in landscapes, architecture and abstraction. $5 for ages 13+, free for 12 and under. The show runs through March 28.

events.title: Holiday Faire at Shadelands Ranch
events.venue: Shadelands Ranch Museum, 2660 Ygnacio Valley Rd
events.description: A tradition since 1983: the historic ranch house fills with handmade gifts from dozens of vendors. Open daily 10am–4pm (until 5pm on Dec 5 and 12), and admission and parking are free. Holiday teas by reservation also run during the Faire.

events.title: MADE + FOUND Artist & Makers Holiday Market
events.venue: KOHO Creative Hub, Japan Center East Mall, 1675 Post St
events.description: More than 30 Japanese, Japanese American and AANHPI makers sell gifts across KOHO and the East Mall. Pick up a passport to collect stamps at shops around Japantown, and there are workshops, entertainment and a free gift-wrap station. Noon–5pm both days.

events.title: Azzedine Alaïa: Sculpting Fashion
events.source: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
events.description: The first major US retrospective of the Tunisian-born Paris couturier, famous for sculpting fabric close to the body, along with pieces by Balenciaga, Schiaparelli and Vionnet from his own collection. Open Tuesday–Sunday.

events.title: Late Night Editions: Holiday (21+)
events.source: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
events.description: A dressy after-hours party at the Legion of Honor with DJs, live music from Radio Gatsby, food trucks, cocktails, a portrait booth and access to the Alaïa fashion exhibition. 21+.

events.title: SF Sketchfest 2027
events.description: The 24th edition of the city's comedy festival: tributes to Martin Short and Broad City, reunions, live podcasts, improv, sketch and stand-up shows at venues around town over two and a half weeks.

events.title: Desi Comedy Fest at SF Sketchfest
events.venue: Punch Line Comedy Club, 444 Battery St
events.description: A South Asian stand-up showcase during Sketchfest with Abhay Nadkarni and Samson Koletkar, plus guests Jay Badlani, Vik Pandya and Priya Puram.

events.title: Lighted Boat Parade
events.venue: San Francisco waterfront (Pier 39 to St. Francis Yacht Club)
events.description: Boats strung with holiday lights cruise the city's northern waterfront in the St. Francis Yacht Club's annual parade, and you can watch for free from the shore.

events.title: Annette A. Aguilar & Beans on the Left
events.venue: Bird & Beckett Books & Records, 653 Chenery St
events.description: NYC-based Latin and Brazilian drummer Annette Aguilar, who has San Francisco roots, comes home with her seven-piece band, which includes violinist Anthony Blea.

events.title: Santa's Fire Truck Ride: San Ramon
events.venue: Athan Downs Park to City Center Bishop Ranch, 6000 Bollinger Canyon Rd
events.source: San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District
events.description: Santa trades his sleigh for a fire engine, leaving Athan Downs Park at 4:30 p.m. and reaching City Center around 6 p.m. Wave from the route, then take free photos with Santa, firefighters and the truck until 8 p.m.

events.title: Santa's Fire Truck Ride: Danville
events.venue: Camino Ramon & Fostoria Way to Danville Veterans Hall, 400 Hartz Ave
events.source: San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District
events.description: Santa rides a fire engine through Danville, starting at 4:30 p.m. and finishing in front of the Veterans Hall around 6 p.m. Free photos with Santa, the crew and the truck continue until 8 p.m.

events.title: Shri Adhyayana Utsavam at the Livermore Temple
events.source: Hindu Community and Cultural Center (Livermore Temple)
events.description: The Vaishnava festival of recitation of the Divya Prabandham runs in two parts: Pagal Pathu (Dec 11-18) and Iraa Pathu (Dec 19-25), with Vaikunta Ekadasi falling on Dec 19.

events.title: Yoga with Janine Ellis: Holiday Edition
events.venue: Bedford Gallery, Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.description: A heart-centered holiday yoga session held inside the Bedford Gallery among the textile works of the High Pile: Concepts in Tufting exhibition, which closes Dec 13.

events.title: Kung Pao Kosher Comedy (34th annual)
events.description: The long-running tradition of Jewish comedy on Christmas in a Chinese restaurant. Two shows a night Dec 24-26: a dinner show (5 p.m. dinner, 6 p.m. show, $95) and an 8:30 p.m. cocktail show ($70). Livestream tickets also offered.

events.title: Live! From the Library: Charged Particles
events.venue: Walnut Creek Library, Oak View Room, 1644 N Broadway
events.description: The jazz trio Charged Particles returns for a free evening of lively music in the library's Oak View Room.

events.title: Live! From the Library: Behind the Scenes of Craft Brewing
events.venue: Walnut Creek Library, Oak View Room, 1644 N Broadway
events.description: Danville Brewing Company brewer Matt Sager covers ingredients, beer styles and the business of a small brewery, with a guided tasting of four beers (21+ to taste) and Q&A. Free.

events.title: PlayGround Solo Performance Festival (10th annual)
events.description: Twenty solo performers and 60 performances of new solo work, Thursdays through Mondays, live on Potrero Hill and simulcast. Admission is free with a suggested $10-$30 donation.

events.title: FOG Design+Art 2027
events.venue: Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture, 2 Marina Blvd
events.description: San Francisco's fair of 20th-century and contemporary design dealers and modern and contemporary art galleries, with talks and the FOG MRKT. A preview gala benefiting SFMOMA is held on Jan 20.

events.title: Fan Halen: Tribute to Van Halen
events.description: A tribute band billed as the most authentic Van Halen tribute, recreating the original lineup's hits note for note.

events.title: Vishnu's Cosmic Ocean
events.venue: Asian Art Museum, Osher Foundation Gallery, 200 Larkin St
events.description: The nearly 20-foot West Mebon Reclining Vishnu, Southeast Asia's largest ancient bronze, from a temple in Angkor-era Cambodia. The museum is its only West Coast stop before it returns to Cambodia. Included with general admission. Museum closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

events.title: The Great Elephant Migration: A Family Gathering
events.venue: Downtown Livermore (Bankhead Plaza, Stockmen's Park and around downtown)
events.description: Free outdoor public art show of 30 life-size Indian elephant sculptures made from dried lantana by Indigenous artisans from the Nilgiri Hills in southern India. Each one is modeled on a real wild elephant. On view through Dec 6.

events.title: The Great Elephant Migration: Closing Reception
events.description: Free closing celebration for the Indian lantana elephant herd in downtown Livermore. If it rains, the ceremony moves to Sunday, Dec 6, 1–3 p.m.

events.title: High Pile: Concepts in Tufting
events.venue: Bedford Gallery, Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.description: Group show of 20 contemporary artists who use tufting as a fine-art medium, going well beyond rugs. Gallery open Wednesday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m., through Dec 13.

events.title: Glow in the Meadow Kick-off
events.description: Free kick-off with live performances, holiday treats, crafts and a countdown to the first lighting of eight light installations. The installations stay up in Central Park Meadow through December.

events.title: Nights of Wonder: Pyramid of Light
events.venue: Redwood Park, Transamerica Pyramid Center, 600 Montgomery St
events.description: First-year holiday market under the redwoods next to the Transamerica Pyramid. Twelve nights, Thursday–Sunday, 6–10 p.m., with gift chalets, Santa, a tree lighting, live music and movie nights. A 21+ late session runs Fridays and Saturdays, 10 p.m.–2 a.m.

events.title: Kimochi Silver Bells Arts & Crafts Faire
events.venue: The Event Center at St. Mary's Cathedral, 1111 Gough St
events.description: Long-running one-day holiday arts, crafts and food fair raising money for Kimochi, the Japantown senior-services nonprofit.

events.title: Winter Rooftop Faire at the Fairmont (Thanksgiving weekend)
events.venue: Fairmont San Francisco Rooftop Garden, 950 Mason St
events.description: Open-air holiday artisan market styled like a European holiday village in the Fairmont's Nob Hill rooftop garden, with local makers, music and lights. Noon–5 p.m. daily; it returns Dec 18–20.

events.title: Winter Rooftop Faire at the Fairmont (Dec 18-20)
events.venue: Fairmont San Francisco Rooftop Garden, 950 Mason St
events.description: Second weekend of the Fairmont's open-air holiday artisan market in its Nob Hill rooftop garden, with local makers, music and lights. Noon–5 p.m. daily.

events.title: Mercatino di Natale: Italian Christmas Market
events.venue: Museo Italo Americano, Fort Mason Center, 2 Marina Blvd, Bldg. C
events.description: Free two-day Italian Christmas market with Italian and Italian American vendors, handmade gifts and seasonal treats.

events.title: Patchwork Show at Union Square Winter Walk
events.description: European-style holiday market with a rotating lineup of independent makers on Maiden Lane. Soft opening Dec 8, grand opening Dec 9, closed Dec 25. Open 11 a.m.–7 p.m. Monday–Wednesday and 11 a.m.–8 p.m. Thursday–Sunday.

events.title: New Year's Day Annadana at the Livermore Temple
events.description: Start 2027 at the Shiva-Vishnu Temple, where prasadam (annadanam) is served to all the devotees who visit on New Year's Day. Families can sponsor the program.

events.title: SF Symphony: Avatar Live in Concert
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: James Cameron's Avatar shown on the big screen while the SF Symphony and Chorus play James Horner's score live, conducted by Sarah Hicks. Also Saturday, Jan 9 at 2 p.m.

events.title: Emanuel Ax Piano Recital
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Pianist Emanuel Ax plays a solo recital of Schumann's Papillons, Schubert's Four Impromptus, D.899, and Chopin pieces including the Polonaise-Fantasy, the Barcarolle and the Scherzo No. 2. Part of the SF Symphony's Great Performers Series.

events.title: SF Symphony: Elim Chan Conducts Elgar's Enigma Variations
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Music Director Designate Elim Chan steps in for Herbert Blomstedt, who withdrew from this program. She conducts Noriko Koide's Swaddling Silk and Gossamer Rain, Mozart's Sinfonia concertante with Alexander Barantschik and Jonathan Vinocour, and Elgar's Enigma Variations. Thursday, Jan 14 at 2 p.m.; Friday and Saturday, Jan 15 and 16, at 7:30 p.m.

events.title: Flora in Focus
events.venue: Harrington Gallery, Firehouse Arts Center, 4444 Railroad Ave
events.description: Floral group show of about 100 works by 12 local artists, with live artist demos on some Saturdays and Ikebana installations during reception week. Reception Feb 6, 1 to 3 p.m. Gallery hours: Wednesday to Friday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

events.title: Come Together: The Beatles Concert Experience
events.venue: Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.description: Beatles tribute concert with favorites like "All My Loving" and "I Want to Hold Your Hand."

events.title: Adrian West Band
events.venue: Lesher Center for the Arts, 1601 Civic Dr
events.description: Six-piece concert by the Adrian West Band with top Bay Area musicians.

events.title: Dread Scott: The Body Politic
events.venue: Gallery 1, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.source: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: Exhibition of Dread Scott's political art, with two new commissions and earlier works. One is the durational performance Defending the Flag, performed Wednesdays 4 to 8 p.m. and Saturdays 1 to 5 p.m. Admission is free for youth and military.

events.title: Mud Frontier: Film Screening & Talkback with Rael San Fratello
events.venue: Screening Room, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.source: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: Screening of the documentary Mud Frontier: Architecture at the Borderlands (63 min), about 3D-printed adobe architecture. Afterward, architects Ronald Rael and Virginia San Fratello take part in a talkback. Free with registration.

events.title: Barbara Stauffacher Solomon: Why? Why Not?
events.venue: Gallery 3, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.source: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: First full look at the late Sea Ranch Supergraphics pioneer's art, design, writing and landscape work, including a new Supergraphic painted on YBCA's walls from her designs. Opens Jan 16.

events.title: Social and Economic Justice Music and the Arts Festival
events.source: Center for Social and Economic Justice
events.description: Day of workshops, song swaps and community performances across music and other art forms, ending with an evening concert. Registration required; volunteers attend free.

events.title: Sahakhom Day (Cambodian Community Day)
events.venue: Bogart Court, Asian Art Museum, 200 Larkin St
events.description: Free First Sunday celebration tied to the Vishnu's Cosmic Ocean exhibition, with Khmer dance performances and a traditional Cambodian Buddhist water blessing.

events.title: Acahub Community Sing-Along
events.venue: Samsung Hall, Asian Art Museum, 200 Larkin St
events.description: Casual a cappella workshop: learn, rehearse and perform a group arrangement in about three hours. No singing experience needed.

events.title: Tiles & Tonics: A Mahjong Soiree
events.venue: County Fair Building, Golden Gate Park, 1199 9th Ave
events.description: Evening of mahjong for all levels, with friendly guidance on hand and mocktails from Ocean Beach Cafe.

events.title: MoAD & SFJAZZ Present Black Nile
events.venue: Museum of the African Diaspora, 685 Mission St
events.description: Intimate set by brothers Aaron and Lawrence Shaw, whose jazz draws on hip-hop sampling and production. $15 general, $7 students/seniors; ticket holders can join a pre-show exhibition tour.

events.title: Thrive @ MoAD: Free Community Day (Dec 12)
events.venue: Museum of the African Diaspora, 685 Mission St
events.description: Second Saturday free admission to all exhibitions, with a family art activity, an International Human Rights Day gallery conversation and short-film screenings.

events.title: Sing-It-Yourself Messiah (47th year)
events.venue: McKenna Theatre, SF State, 1600 Holloway Ave
events.description: Audience sing-along of Handel's Messiah with the Golden Gate Symphony Orchestra & Chorus under Urs Leonhardt Steiner. Seasoned singers and first-timers welcome.

events.title: Arun Ramamurthy Trio: Carnatic Jazz
events.venue: Joe Henderson Lab, SFJAZZ Center, 201 Franklin St
events.description: Carnatic violinist Arun Ramamurthy, co-founder of Brooklyn Raga Massive, with drummer Sameer Gupta and bassist Damon Banks, blending South Indian raga and jazz. Sets at 7 and 8:30 pm.

events.title: MLK March 2027
events.description: Annual 1.5-mile commemorative march from the Caltrain station to Yerba Buena Gardens, ending with an interfaith commemoration. Free, no registration; arrive early.

events.title: Sukhawat Ali Khan & Cali Qawwali: Sufi and Kirtan Concert
events.description: Qawwali, ghazal, raag-based and kirtan songs led by Sham Chaurasi gharana vocalist Sukhawat Ali Khan. $20 in advance, $25 at the door.

events.title: ICDT! Into the Woods Jr.
events.source: I Can Do That! Performing Arts Center
events.description: Youth production of Sondheim's fairy-tale musical, with four casts across two weekends (Fri 7 pm, Sat 2 and 7 pm, Sun 2 pm).

events.title: ICDT! Footloose
events.venue: Del Valle Theatre, 1963 Tice Valley Blvd
events.source: I Can Do That! Performing Arts Center
events.description: Teen mainstage production of Footloose The Musical over two weekends (Fri 7 pm, Sat 2 and 7 pm, Sun 2 pm). Contains mature themes and language.

events.title: Cimafunk: New Year's Eve Celebration
events.description: Cuban singer Cimafunk and his band La Tribu ring in 2027 with an Afro-Cuban funk dance party. Two sets, 8 and 10:30 p.m.; both include sparkling wine, party favors and an open dance floor, and the late show adds New York and SF countdowns plus a balloon drop.

events.title: Swing Into The Holidays with Caity Gyorgy & Christian Wiggs
events.description: Family-friendly holiday matinee: jazz vocalists Caity Gyorgy and Christian Wiggs swing through carols and songs from classic holiday movies, with plenty of sing-alongs.

events.title: An Evening with Itzhak Perlman
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Violin great Itzhak Perlman tells his story through conversation, family photos and clips from the documentary Itzhak, and plays alongside longtime pianist Rohan De Silva. Part of the SF Symphony's Great Performers Series.

events.title: City Ballet San Francisco: The Nutcracker
events.venue: Palace of Fine Arts Theatre, 3301 Lyon St
events.description: City Ballet San Francisco stages Tchaikovsky's holiday classic in two weekend matinees, Saturday Dec 12 and Sunday Dec 13 at 2 p.m. (doors 1 p.m.).

events.title: Stellabration: A 30th Anniversary Tribute to Stella
events.venue: Palace of Fine Arts Theatre, 3301 Lyon St
events.source: SF Sketchfest / Palace of Fine Arts Theatre
events.description: SF Sketchfest reunites Michael Ian Black, Michael Showalter and David Wain to mark 30 years of their comedy troupe Stella, with conversation and rare video. Doors 3 p.m.

events.title: GTTA Sankranti, Lohri & Pongal Grand Mela
events.venue: Iron Horse Middle School, 12601 Alcosta Blvd
events.description: The Greater Tri-Valley Telugu Association's harvest-festival mela for Sankranti, Lohri and Pongal: festive decor, cultural and dance performances, a rangoli (muggulu) contest and a Sankranti vegetarian lunch included with admission. Register on the GTTA site.

events.title: Noon Year's Eve Celebration
events.description: Kids and families count down to noon with crafts, refreshments and a photo booth at the San Ramon Library (100 Montgomery St). Free; entry closes when the room is full.

events.title: The Puppet Company: The Nutcracker
events.description: A puppet version of the Nutcracker story, from Clara's battle with the Mouse King to the Land of the Sugar Plum Fairy, at the Danville Library (400 Front St). Free, no registration needed.

events.title: Fratello Marionettes: The North Pole Review
events.description: Free all-ages marionette show with a skating star, high-kicking dancers and acrobatic penguins, in the Oak View Room on the second floor of the Walnut Creek Library (1644 N. Broadway).

events.title: The Three Billy Goats Gruff (Holiday Edition) - followed by festive Crafts!
events.description: A holiday spin on the troll-under-the-bridge tale for young kids, followed by holiday crafts, at Dougherty Station Library (17017 Bollinger Canyon Rd). Free.

events.title: GaHee Park: Behind the Curtain
events.venue: Second Floor Galleries, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.description: Last weeks to see GaHee Park's dreamlike, slightly unsettling figurative paintings at YBCA; the show closes January 3.

events.title: Rael San Fratello: Prototypes and Provocations
events.venue: Gallery 2, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.description: The largest survey yet of Bay Area design studio Rael San Fratello, known for 3D-printed architecture and work that mixes new technology with traditional building methods like adobe.

events.title: Artist & Curator Talk: Rael San Fratello
events.venue: Screening Room, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.description: Ronald Rael and Virginia San Fratello discuss their YBCA exhibition, Prototypes and Provocations, with the show's curator.

events.title: Free Art Workshop: Mini Parol Suncatchers
events.venue: Grand Lobby, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.description: Drop-in, all-ages workshop making small parol-shaped suncatchers, inspired by the Filipino lantern tradition and the upcoming Parol Lantern Festival. Materials provided; take your piece home.

events.title: Free Art Workshop: Nutcracker Ornaments
events.venue: Grand Lobby, Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.description: Drop-in, all-ages workshop building miniature nutcracker ornaments, tied to the Dance-Along Nutcracker at YBCA. Materials provided.

events.title: Mahjong and Mocktails
events.venue: Asian Art Museum, Bowes Court, 200 Larkin St
events.description: Drop-in mahjong for every level on Thursday evenings (Dec 3, 10 and 17 from 5 p.m.), with teachers on hand to explain the rules and mocktails available. Included with museum admission.

events.title: Ha Chong-Hyun: Retrospective
events.venue: Asian Art Museum, Yang Yamazaki Pavilion, 200 Larkin St
events.description: First North American museum survey of Korean abstract painter Ha Chong-Hyun, covering six decades of large, heavily textured canvases. Timed tickets required. Museum closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

events.title: Garuda in Bali
events.venue: Asian Art Museum, Hambrecht Contemporary Gallery, 200 Larkin St
events.description: Balinese wooden sculptures and paintings from the late 1800s and early 1900s telling the story of Garuda, the bird-warrior who carries the Hindu god Vishnu. Included with general admission. Closes Jan 4.

events.title: Kim Minwook: On Carving, Bending, and Binding Wood
events.venue: Asian Art Museum, Koret Korean Galleries, 200 Larkin St
events.description: First solo museum show for Korean woodworker Kim Minwook, whose turned and bent wood pieces keep the cracks and knots of the original tree. Included with general admission.

events.title: Vijay Iyer & Wadada Leo Smith
events.venue: Miner Auditorium, SFJAZZ Center, 201 Franklin St
events.description: Duets from Indian-American pianist Vijay Iyer, a MacArthur Fellow, and trumpeter Wadada Leo Smith, playing music from their two ECM albums, A Cosmic Rhythm With Each Stroke and Defiant Life.

events.title: Morning Ragas: Akshay Naresh (bansuri) with tabla
events.venue: Bird & Beckett Books & Records, 653 Chenery St
events.description: The monthly Sunday-morning raga series continues with Bay Area bansuri flutist Akshay Naresh, trained in both Hindustani and Carnatic music, playing morning ragas with tabla accompaniment.

events.title: SanGaMa Christmas & New Year Celebration
events.venue: Jose Maria Amador Elementary School MPR, 2100 E Cantara Dr
events.description: The Bay Area Kerala community group's Christmas and New Year dinner party, with carols, dances, songs, Santa, a DJ dance floor and the SanGaMa SuperStars local talent showcase. Tickets on the SanGaMa site.

events.title: Carlos Reyes
events.description: Paraguayan-born violinist and electric harpist Carlos Reyes and his Electrick Symphony, mixing folk, rock, jazz, Latin and classical music.

events.title: Make A Difference for Pleasanton Volunteer Festival
events.description: Free, family-friendly festival on MLK weekend where local nonprofits and community groups share volunteer opportunities. Walk the aisles and sign up on the spot.

events.title: Winter Break Art at the Bothwell
events.description: Four-day winter break art camp for ages 6 to 15 (Dec 28-31, 10 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.) with painting, drawing, sculpture and more. Two classrooms, 15 students each; registration required.

events.title: After Dark: Unplug and Play (18+)
events.description: The monthly adults-only night for unplugging: science trivia, games and a chance to meet people, with the museum's exhibits open. 18+.

events.title: Curious Countdown: New Year's Eve at the Exploratorium
events.description: A daytime, all-ages New Year's Eve with countdowns around the museum, from a model geyser to a liquid nitrogen burst of 3,000 ping pong balls, plus dancing and the Glow exhibition.

events.title: Music at the Plaza: Holiday Saturdays
events.description: Free live music downtown each holiday Saturday, 1 to 3 p.m.: David Martin & Rob Ross (Nov 28), Mike Annuzzi (Dec 5), Michelle Lambert (Dec 12) and Lorin Rowan (Dec 19).

events.title: The Heart of It & Hearts of Danville: Opening Reception
events.venue: Village Theatre & Art Gallery, 233 Front St
events.description: Opening of The Heart of It, a Lamorinda Arts Alliance group show, and the unveiling of 16 artist-painted heart sculptures for the Hearts of Danville public art display downtown (on view through March 25).

events.title: DAPA: Shrek The Musical KIDS & Spotlight Show Choir
events.venue: Dougherty Valley Performing Arts Center, 10550 Albion Rd
events.description: Diamond Academy of Performing Arts young performers in Shrek The Musical KIDS after an opening set by the Spotlight Show Choir. Two shows: 3 p.m. (Fiona cast) and 4:30 p.m. (Shrek cast).

events.title: SF Symphony: Hook in Concert (Fri)
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Spielberg's Peter Pan sequel Hook screens on the big screen while Sarah Hicks leads the orchestra through John Williams's score live. Under-18s get 50% off.

events.title: SF Symphony: Hook in Concert (Sat matinee)
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Afternoon showing of Hook with John Williams's score played live by the SF Symphony under Sarah Hicks. Tickets for kids and teens under 18 are half price.

events.title: Hilary Hahn, Matthias Goerne & Gloria Chien
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Violinist Hilary Hahn, baritone Matthias Goerne and pianist Gloria Chien share a recital of Beethoven sonatas and songs, Bach arias, and the premiere of Reena Esmail's new SF Symphony commission Wir.

events.title: Nob Hill Holiday Lighting Celebration
events.description: The Nob Hill Association's yearly park lighting, with a countdown, a set from the CSB Hawk Combo Band and Grace Cathedral choir students. Free for everyone. If it rains, it moves into Grace Cathedral.

events.title: 555 California Holiday Tree Lighting & Mercantile
events.description: Sunset Mercantile brings a holiday makers market to the Financial District plaza for the day, with food and activities. The big real tree gets lit at 6 p.m.

events.title: Ghost Ship Symphony
events.description: A memorial concert for the 10th anniversary of the Ghost Ship fire. Local musicians premiere Symphony No. 1 by fire survivor Alexandrea Archuleta, commissioned by Vital Arts. Lunaxix and Zachary James Watkins open the night.

events.title: American Bach Soloists: Handel's Messiah
events.description: American Bach Soloists' annual Messiah at Grace Cathedral, about 2.5 hours with one intermission. Doors open at 6:30 p.m. There's a second performance Dec 11 at 7:30 p.m. Tickets through americanbach.org.

events.title: TEAM Theatre Improv: Holiday Tale
events.venue: Front Row Theater, 17011 Bollinger Canyon Rd
events.description: TEAM Theatre's improvisers turn audience suggestions into a made-up-on-the-spot holiday story in the style of a greeting-card-channel movie. Best for ages 12 and up. General admission.

events.title: Sing You a Merry Christmas
events.description: An hour-long family sing-along show. Toys from St. Nicholas's workshop follow clues to the meaning of Christmas, with familiar carols along the way. More shows Dec 19 at 11 a.m. and Dec 22–23 at 3 p.m.

events.title: Monthly Hanuman Chalisa Chanting (108 times)
events.venue: Sri Datta Sai Temple, 1901 San Ramon Valley Blvd
events.description: Held on the third Saturday of each month: devotees chant the Hanuman Chalisa 108 times together. Starts at 9 a.m. and runs about four hours.

events.title: A Brass and Organ Christmas
events.description: The Bay Brass, made up of players from the SF Symphony, Ballet and Opera orchestras, plays old and new holiday music with the cathedral's 7,466-pipe organ.

events.title: SF Symphony Chamber Series: Schumann & Shostakovich
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: SF Symphony musicians play two chamber works with piano: Schumann's Piano Quartet in E-flat and Shostakovich's Piano Quintet in G minor.

events.title: The Genesis Project at Grace Cathedral
events.description: Artist Emma Fineman's site-specific piece for SF Art Week mixes dance, sound, film and big movable paintings that reimagine the Book of Genesis next to the cathedral's murals. Three nights only, Jan 21–23.

events.title: SF Symphony: Alsop Conducts Shostakovich 5
events.venue: Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave
events.description: Marin Alsop conducts the West Coast premiere of John Adams's The Rock You Stand On, Barber's Violin Concerto with Nemanja Radulović, and Shostakovich's Fifth Symphony. The program repeats Jan 24 at 2 p.m.

events.title: Valley Concert Chorale: Sing-It-Yourself Messiah
events.description: Valley Concert Chorale's annual Sing-It-Yourself Messiah: bring your voice and join the chorus for Handel's Messiah.

events.title: Valley Concert Chorale: Under the Evergreens (Livermore)
events.venue: Asbury United Methodist Church, 4743 East Ave
events.description: Holiday concert of carols celebrating Christmas, winter and December, with music by Rutter, Britten (Ceremony of Carols), Tavener, Chilcott and traditional favorites. Repeats Dec 12 in Pleasanton.

events.title: Valley Concert Chorale: Under the Evergreens (Pleasanton)
events.description: Holiday concert of carols celebrating Christmas, winter and December, with selections by John Rutter, Benjamin Britten, John Tavener, Penelope Thwaites and Bob Chilcott plus traditional carols.

events.title: Daniel Glover Benefit Recital: Remembering Beethoven
events.description: Benefit piano recital by Daniel Glover remembering Beethoven, presented by Valley Concert Chorale.

events.title: SPARC: A Holiday Soiree
events.description: Professional actors give intimate, semi-staged readings of short holiday stories, with songs and treats; ticket includes a non-alcoholic drink and holiday treat. Fri-Sat 7:30 p.m., Sun 4 p.m.

events.title: Winter Around the World at Dublin Library
events.venue: Dublin Library, Virginia Bennett Room, 200 Civic Plaza
events.description: All-ages drop-in activities exploring winter holidays around the world, including Christmas, Kwanzaa, Yule, Three Kings Day and Hanukkah. Supplies provided while they last.

events.title: Tri-Valley Symphonics in Concert
events.description: Free concert by the high school group Tri-Valley Symphonics, performing music that tells the story of The Lion King.

events.title: Winter Craft Festival at Dublin Library
events.description: Make a last-minute handmade gift, with a wrapping station and goody bags for all, while supplies last.

events.title: Team Gingerbread Competition (teens)
events.description: Teens team up to build the sturdiest, best-looking gingerbread house in an hour, judged by a teen panel, with hot cocoa and a holiday movie. Supplies provided.

events.title: Kassa Overall
events.venue: Joe Henderson Lab, SFJAZZ Center, 201 Franklin St
events.description: Drummer, producer and rapper Kassa Overall plays two nights (7 and 8:30 p.m. Dec 4-5) with music from CREAM, his reimagining of hip-hop classics. Pay-what-you-wish tiers.

events.title: David Murray Quartet
events.venue: Joe Henderson Lab, SFJAZZ Center, 201 Franklin St
events.description: Tenor sax titan David Murray with Marta Sanchez, Luke Stewart and Russell Carter. Sets at 7 and 8:30 p.m. Dec 19, 6 and 7:30 p.m. Dec 20.

events.title: Elf The Musical
events.description: Touring production of the holiday musical about Buddy the elf. Check BroadwaySF for showtimes.

events.title: The Outsiders
events.description: The Tony-winning Broadway musical based on S.E. Hinton's novel. Check BroadwaySF for showtimes.

events.title: Mannheim Steamroller Christmas
events.description: Chip Davis's Mannheim Steamroller holiday concert tour. Check BroadwaySF for show time.

events.title: Hadestown
events.description: Short return engagement of the Tony-winning folk-opera musical. Check BroadwaySF for showtimes.

events.title: Jersey Boys
events.description: The Tony-winning musical about Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons. Check BroadwaySF for showtimes.

events.title: Wicked: Part One in Concert
events.description: Screening of the Wicked film with live musical accompaniment. Check BroadwaySF for show time.

events.title: World Ballet Company: The Nutcracker
events.description: Touring World Ballet Company performs the holiday classic. Check BroadwaySF for show time.

events.title: Sankatahara Chaturthi at Sri Datta Sai Temple
events.venue: Sri Datta Sai Temple, 1901 San Ramon Valley Blvd
events.description: Monthly Sankatahara Chaturthi observance with abhishekam and archana for Lord Ganesha. Check the temple calendar for timing.

events.title: Pradosha Puja at Sri Datta Sai Temple
events.venue: Sri Datta Sai Temple, 1901 San Ramon Valley Blvd
events.description: Shiva Pradosha puja (abhishekam and archana) at sunset on Trayodashi; the temple says it is typically performed around 7 p.m.

events.title: Lau Noah & Adam Neely
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center (Joe Henderson Lab), 201 Franklin St
events.description: Spanish guitarist-singer Lau Noah teams up with bassist Adam Neely (Sungazer) for an intimate duo set drawing on their EP The Way Under. Two sets, 7 and 8:30 p.m.; pay-what-you-wish tiers $35-$55.

events.title: Aaron Shaw: And So It Is
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center (Joe Henderson Lab), 201 Franklin St
events.description: L.A. tenor saxophonist Aaron Shaw, a spiritual-jazz voice from the Leimert Park scene, plays music from his debut album And So It Is. Sets at 6 and 7:30 p.m.; pay-what-you-wish $30-$50.

events.title: Skylar Tang Quartet
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center (Joe Henderson Lab), 201 Franklin St
events.description: Homecoming bandleader debut for Bay Area-raised trumpeter Skylar Tang, an SFJAZZ High School All-Stars alum now working in New York. Sets at 7 and 8:30 p.m. (the early set is nearly sold out); $30-$50.

events.title: Maz Jobrani at Cobb's Comedy Club
events.description: Comedian and actor Maz Jobrani brings his stand-up to North Beach for a weekend run. Shows Friday Dec 11 and Saturday Dec 12 at 7 and 9:15 p.m.; see the venue's ticket page for prices.

events.title: Group Satyanarayana Vratam (Pournami) at Sri Datta Sai Temple
events.venue: Sri Datta Sai Temple, 1901 San Ramon Valley Blvd
events.description: The temple's monthly full-moon group Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Vratam, where families perform the puja together. Check the temple calendar for timing and sponsorship details.

events.title: Jenny Scheinman Quintet: One Hundred Years Today
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center (Joe Henderson Lab), 201 Franklin St
events.description: Violinist Jenny Scheinman, who moves between jazz and Americana, plays music from her new album inspired by her grandmother's 1920s-30s travels. Jan 7-8, sets at 7 and 8:30 p.m.; $35-$55.

events.title: Kendrick Scott Quintet
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center (Joe Henderson Lab), 201 Franklin St
events.description: SFJAZZ Collective drummer Kendrick Scott leads an all-star quintet with trumpeter Marquis Hill and saxophonist Walter Smith III in the 100-seat Lab. Sat 7 and 8:30 p.m., Sun 6 and 7:30 p.m.; $40-$65.

events.title: Film Screening & Discussion: The Eyes of Ghana
events.venue: Museum of the African Diaspora, 685 Mission St
events.description: Free screening of Ben Proudfoot's documentary about cinematographer Chris Hesse's effort to save a trove of films from Ghana's independence era, followed by a talk with producer Nana Adwoa Frimpong and Prof. Amina Mama. Part of MoAD's free Thrive community day.

events.title: Tiny Tuesday: Puddles and Plants
events.description: A wetlands-themed morning for kids 2-5 and their grown-ups, with animal ambassadors, a puppet show, sing-along, crafts and a library storytime. Pre-registration closes Jan 10.

events.title: Goldings, Bernstein, Stewart Organ Trio
events.venue: SFJAZZ Center (Joe Henderson Lab), 201 Franklin St
events.description: Organist Larry Goldings, guitarist Peter Bernstein and drummer Bill Stewart, together for three-plus decades, play three nights behind their 2026 album Rhombus. Fri-Sat 7 and 8:30 p.m., Sun 6 and 7:30 p.m.; $40-$65.

events.title: San Francisco Art Week at YBCA (free admission)
events.venue: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts, 701 Mission St
events.source: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: YBCA hosts the official SF Art Week kickoff on Jan 16 and keeps gallery admission and programs free all week, with an Art Week lounge, a Burning An Illusion screening (Jan 16) and a curator tour of the Stauffacher Solomon show (Jan 21).

events.title: Yerba Buena Illuminated: Anna Luisa Petrisko
events.venue: Humboldt Bank Building facade, 785 Market St
events.source: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.description: A new outdoor video work of cloud, water and tree 'portals' projected across the 95-foot Beaux-Arts face of the Humboldt Bank Building, viewable free from the street after dark.

events.title: Eliane Elias Quartet: Jobim Centennial & The Art of Bossa Nova
events.description: Brazilian pianist-singer Eliane Elias marks Antonio Carlos Jobim's 100th with two Jobim nights (Jan 22-23, 7:30 p.m.), then a bossa nova program on Sunday Jan 24 at 7 p.m. Tickets $45-$115.
